message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. The facts describe a scheme of falsifying VAT special invoices (增值税专用发票) without real transaction, for large amount, and receiving fees. This is typical crime of "虚开增值税专用发票罪" (illegal issuance of VAT special invoices). The key rule: need to include specific purpose if mentioned: "用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款" etc. In this case, the purpose seems to be to obtain input tax deduction? The facts: they opened invoices for 6250 tons of corn, amount 9,968,750 yuan, tax 1,146,847 yuan. The company (中饲) is a feed processing enterprise, exempt from tax, so they didn't need to deduct. They opened invoices as financial settlement documents. They later had to pay tax. The crime is "虚开增值税专用发票罪". The examples earlier show they sometimes list "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". But here there is no mention of export tax refund or deduction. The purpose is to get financial settlement, maybe to claim input tax? The company is exempt, so they didn't claim deduction. So maybe just "虚开增值税专用发票". Also there is "收取开票费" which is part of the crime. The crime may also be "非法收购、运输、加工、出售国家重点保护植物" etc but not relevant.

Thus answer likely single crime: 虚开增值税专用发票.
